title: feat(i18n): console flow labels follow the server's declared fallback chain
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBP9pYn3ZkhGT2R2hstwEY6w)_
Fixes #36809

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — the new member is a response field the console reads, not something a metadata author writes; no skills/ page teaches `GET /i18n/locales` or how the console resolves flow labels

> This PR adds a member to a published response (`GetLocalesResponseSchema`, non-test `packages/spec/src/**`) and so **owes a contract-tier L2 review** before it lands (seat route 7124316383, L1-b).

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：声明了回退语言的应用里，控制台的流程名称、流程步骤名和流程表单字段文字，在当前语言缺译时改显示回退语言的译文，和服务端一致；没声明回退语言的应用不变。
- 为什么做：控制台此前只认当前语言，同一个流程标签在服务端和控制台显示成两种文字，违背了翻译文档"按应用声明的回退链降级"的承诺。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个流程标签显示成回退语言或作者原文，不影响任何数据；回退本次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Carrier: `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales` gains `fallbackChain`** (optional `string[]`), not discovery `locale`. Why this door:

- It already carries the other half of the resolvers' options, `sourceLocale` (the `defaultLocale` the server hands the resolvers), so the console reads the whole `ResolveOptions` declaration from one answer.
- It has one producer (the runtime's `/i18n` domain). Discovery has two (`HttpDispatcher` and `metadata-protocol`'s `getDiscovery`), and adding it to one would let two machine-readable answers about one boot disagree.
- Its value comes from `II18nService.getFallbackLocale()`, read with the same feature-detected accessor and the same non-empty condition as `metaTranslateOptions` (`@objectstack/rest`) uses for every server-side metadata translation. A service with no accessor (the core in-memory provider) or an empty answer serves no member: the server threads a declaration and never invents one.

**Console:**

- `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts` reads the locale list next to the active language's bundle (in parallel). If a chain is declared and the language is not `sourceLocale` (the resolvers skip the chain for it), it fetches each fallback locale's bundle and keeps its `flows` group. It lays them next to the app namespace through `withDeclaredFlowsFallback` (`@object-ui/i18n`). With no declared chain, the answer is exactly what it was before. A failure in either extra read gives that same answer.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowsBundle.ts`: `activeFlowsBundle` now also returns the fallback locales' rows. The new `flowsResolveOptions` returns `{ locale, fallbackChain, defaultLocale }`, the options the server passes. The new `flowsLocaleChain` gives the order the spec's private `localeChain` walks, for the keys that no spec resolver reads. The module doc now describes what the code does.
- `flowLabels.ts` (`flowLabelTranslations` takes the declared options; `useFlowLabelTranslations` passes them), `FlowRunner.tsx` (flow name, field copy per key, option labels), `flow-label-translations.tsx` (Studio rail) and `stageChangeStarts.tsx` (stage confirm) pass the options to `translateFlow` / `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel` / `resolveFlowScreenFieldOptions`.
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` now covers what the console does. `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` is regenerated with the new member, and `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` is regenerated (the `+1` key is the `Metadata-protocol: added`).

## Tests

<details><summary>New pins (files named for this card) and runs</summary>

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n-locales-fallback-chain-36809.test.ts`: the member comes from `getFallbackLocale()` (spy called, value followed). It is absent with no accessor, an `undefined` answer, an empty answer, or the core memory provider. The body parses as `GetLocalesResponseSchema`.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/flowLabels-fallback-chain-36809.test.ts`: with a declared fallback, the console answer equals the spec resolvers' answer with the server's options (flow label, approval step) and covers the plain node and untitled screen. No chain gives the old answer. An authored-language request walks no chain. The array survives the real i18next store. `flowsLocaleChain` visits the same locales as the resolvers in 5 cases.
- `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.fallbackChain-36809.test.tsx`: the real loader with URL-routed fetch. A declared chain reads the fallback text and matches the server. No chain means no extra bundle read. The authored language means no fallback read. A failed locale read degrades to the old answer.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/FlowRunner.fallbackChain-36809.test.tsx`: the runner's flow name and field label come from the fallback, and the placeholder comes from the active language.
- Updated: `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx` (the session pin now expects the locale-list read next to the bundle read, both with the bearer).

Runs (head `b276ff4e`):
- runtime: 4 files / 74 tests passed (new pin, anonymous-deny, supported-locales, envelope conformance).
- ui: i18n 3 files / 20 tests; console + FlowRunner + stage confirm + FlowCanvas 5 files / 47 tests; FlowRunner suite 19 files / 129 tests; new runner + loader pins 2 files / 6 tests. All passed.
- typecheck: `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-time, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after each)</summary>

- `flowsResolveOptions` forced to `{ locale }` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `39830597` to `fe1e4a35`): 4 of 12 tests in the i18n pin went red. Restored, blob equals HEAD.
- The producer's `fallbackChain` spread deleted from `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` (blob `ca4e8bdd` to `d1a26537`): 2 of 6 tests in the runtime pin went red. Restored, blob equals HEAD.
- Both subjects resolve from `src` (relative imports), so no dist preflight was needed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- One extra round trip when a fallback is declared and the language is not the authored one: the fallback bundle is fetched after the locale list answers. App labels for the active language reach the screen together with it. With no declared chain, only the parallel locale-list read is added.
- `flowsLocaleChain` mirrors the spec's private `localeChain`. A parity pin holds it equal to `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel`'s walk. Exporting the spec's own helper would remove the copy, but that is a public spec export outside this claim (carrier: none, noted, not filed).
- The file adapter collapses `fallbackLocale || defaultLocale || 'en'` at boot, so a file-backed stack with no `fallbackLocale` serves its `defaultLocale` as the chain. The console now follows that too, as the server does.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates and two-minute check</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 120 families. All 120 ran locally. 116 exited 0. 3 exited 3 (prerequisite not met, so NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs them): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone cannot reach the pinned fixture), `spec check:skill-examples` (needs a `client-react` build), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full build). `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` had one timeout under shared-box load (`js-comment-mask-returns-interpolation-9424`); the file passed on its own (8/8). `--ran` reconciliation: 120 derived, 117 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 14/14 up to date after `--fix` regenerated `check:docs`.
- `overlap-check --branch`: VERDICT clean (merges cleanly with origin/main and with #36881 / #36857, which share files).
- Read first, by risk: `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts` (the new reads), `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowsBundle.ts` (the reserved tree entry and the chain walk), `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` (the producer hunk).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/flowLabels-fallback-chain-36809.test.ts` should report 12 passed.

</details>

## Fix round 1 (L1 REWORK 7127286361 / contract review FAIL 7127267955 on b276ff4e → ee54ef8c)

- **M1: closed.** `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts` negotiates the console language against the same `/i18n/locales` answer's `locales[].code` (`resolveLocaleAmong(lang, codes) ?? lang`, the matching `negotiatedTranslationLocale` runs) before the authored-language check, before the fallback filter and before the resolvers; the negotiated tag rides `DeclaredFlowsFallback.locale`, `flowsResolveOptions` passes it as `locale`, and `activeFlowsBundle` / `flowLabelTranslations` key by it. Pins with alias tags in `loadLanguage.fallbackChain-36809.test.tsx`: a `zh-Hans` and a `zh` console on a `zh-CN`-authored stack with fallback `en` read the authored Chinese (equal to the server's answer for the negotiated request) and fetch no `en` bundle; a `ja` console on a stack holding `ja-JP` negotiates to `ja-JP` and still reads the `en` fallback. Ablation (raw tag instead of the negotiated one): 3 of 7 loader tests red, restored.
- **S1: closed.** Claim amendment 7127305468 names `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx` and `ui/packages/i18n/src/index.ts`.
- **N2: closed.** The `fallbackChain` describe and jsdoc in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` say the member is absent when the i18n service reports no fallback, and that the request tag is negotiated against `locales[].code` first; `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` regenerated, `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` explains the negotiation.
- **N1: kept.** Sharing the `/i18n/locales` read with `loadLocales.ts` needs that file, outside the claimed surface; one extra request per language load, no correctness effect.

Line budget: 18 files, +957/−77 = 1,034 changed lines (one PR for the card), under the 3,000-line line.
